answer: Each agent identity must run inside a distinct hardware enclave whose vendor-signed serial key emits a signed pulse every block, exposing one live thread per serial. A terrace of verifiers paid from protocol fees can demand a fresh attestation; a duplicate serial or a second thread from the same enclave triggers a graduated sanction: first suspension, then burn of the shared credential. Extra identities need separate enclaves costing C per epoch amortized, so n identities gain n(R-C); deterrence holds only while R<C, and rented cloud enclaves keep C linear.
